# Ring MCP — Full Reference

FastMCP 3.4+ server for comprehensive Ring device management.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| RING_USERNAME | Yes | — | Ring account email |
| RING_PASSWORD | Yes | — | Ring account password |
| RING_TOKEN | No | — | Existing OAuth token |
| HOST | No | 0.0.0.0 | Server bind address |
| PORT | No | 10729 | HTTP API port |
| LOG_LEVEL | No | INFO | Logging level |
| CACHE_TTL | No | 300 | Cache TTL in seconds |
| RATE_LIMIT | No | 10 | Requests per minute per client |
| REDIS_URL | No | — | Redis connection for distributed cache |
| RING_HTTP_API_ORIGIN | No | http://127.0.0.1:10729 | Base URL for web_sota |
| RING_MQTT_ENABLED | No | — | Enable ring-mqtt bridge |
| RING_MQTT_URL | No | mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 | MQTT broker URL |
| RING_MQTT_USERNAME | No | — | MQTT username |
| RING_MQTT_PASSWORD | No | — | MQTT password |
| RING_MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX | No | ring | MQTT topic prefix |
| RING_MQTT_CLIENT_ID | No | ring-mcp-bridge | MQTT client ID |

## Ports

- Frontend (Vite): 10728
- Backend (FastAPI): 10729
- Backend (stdio MCP): standard input/output

## Tools

### Device Management
- `get_devices(force_refresh)` — List all Ring devices with status
- `get_device_details(device_id)` — Get detailed info for a specific device
- `get_device_events(device_id, limit)` — Recent events for a device
- `get_live_stream_url(device_id)` — Temporary live stream URL for cameras

### Security System
- `set_arm_status(device_id, status)` — Arm/disarm security systems (CRITICAL)
- `trigger_chime(device_id)` — Test doorbell chime

### Monitoring
- `health_check()` — Full service and Ring API connectivity health check

## Architecture

```
ring_mcp/
  __init__.py         — FastMCP stdio server entry point
  http_server.py      — FastAPI HTTP server with CORS, REST endpoints, WebRTC streaming
  server.py           — FastMCP server with tool registration and helpers
  composition.py      — Multi-server composition support
  local_llm.py        — Local LLM integration (Ollama)
  ring_mqtt_bridge.py — MQTT bridge for Ring Alarm base station
  core/
    ring_client_modern.py — Async Ring API client
    ring_client.py        — Legacy Ring API client
    token_manager.py      — OAuth token management
    port_manager.py       — Port conflict resolution
    exceptions.py         — Custom exception hierarchy
  tools/
    security_system_tools.py — Alarm arm/disarm tools
    doorbell_tools.py        — Doorbell chime and event tools
    fire_safety_tools.py     — Fire/CO alarm tools
    camera_tools.py          — Camera streaming tools
    monitoring_tools.py      — System health monitoring
    automation_tools.py      — Automation/rule tools
    help_tool.py             — Interactive help tools
    status_tool.py           — System status tools
  utils/
    rate_limiter.py     — Rate limiting utilities

web_sota/              — Vite + React fleet UI
native/                — Tauri desktop shell (NSIS installer)
```

## REST API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| /health | GET | Backend liveness health check |
| /api/v1/health | GET | Detailed health status |
| /api/v1/devices | GET | List all devices |
| /api/v1/devices/{id} | GET | Device details |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/events | GET | Device events |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/stream/webrtc | GET | WebRTC stream signaling |
| /api/v1/arm/{id} | POST | Arm alarm |
| /api/v1/disarm/{id} | POST | Disarm alarm |
| /api/v1/chime/{id} | POST | Trigger doorbell chime |
| /api/v1/chat | POST | Chat completion via local LLM |
| /api/v1/logs | GET | Recent logs from ring buffer |
| /api/v1/credentials | GET/POST | Ring credential management |
| /api/v1/llm/discover | GET | LLM provider auto-discovery |
| /api/health | GET | Health check |
| /api/status | GET | Server status |
| /api/skills | GET | List available skills |
| /docs | GET | Swagger UI |
| /redoc | GET | ReDoc API docs |
| /openapi.json | GET | OpenAPI schema |

## Tool Categories

| Category | Tools | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| Device Management | get_devices, get_device_details, get_device_events | List, query, and monitor Ring devices |
| Security | set_arm_status | Arm/disarm burglar alarm systems |
| Doorbell | trigger_chime | Test doorbell hardware |
| Camera | get_live_stream_url | Generate temporary streaming URLs |
| Monitoring | health_check | System health and Ring API connectivity |

## Transport Modes

- **stdio**: Default for Claude Desktop (`mcp.run(transport="stdio")`)
- **HTTP**: REST API on port 10729 (uvicorn)
- **Tauri**: Embedded backend via PyInstaller onefile binary
